$$テイタニア$$
「Then may I ask you something?」

323:t_10:55.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Tell me about $$フィアナ$$.」

323:t_10:56.en:
$$カレン$$
「...All right. I'll tell you as much as I know.」

324:t_000:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Good... All units have deployed.」

324:t_000:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「$$グルフェー$$ has many $$マーティアル$$ believers. If we waste time, things will get troublesome.」

324:t_000:2.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Let's go. We'll take that town before $$マーティアル$$ comes out.」

324:t_000:3.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Captain...! ATs are coming from the town!」

324:t_000:4.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Tch... Are they guards the town hired? ...How many are there!?」

324:t_001:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(The work is good. You've helped me, $$ゴウト$$.)

324:t_001:3.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Would a scout deliberately come out where we can see it!?」

324:t_001:4.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Then it's some kind of trap...」

324:t_001:5.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「I don't know...! But if it's a challenge to the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$, we'll accept!」

324:t_002:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Captain! I've confirmed an AT approaching us!」

324:t_002:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Has help come for him!?」

324:t_003:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「It's an $$エルドスピーネ$$! Has $$マーティアル$$ already arrived!?」

324:t_003:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「B-but it seems to be alone!」

324:t_004:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Is that pilot planning to support that $$ドッグ$$?」

324:t_004:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「But they don't seem to be coordinating...」

324:t_004:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I need neither words nor feelings... But I'll seek $$キリコ$$...)

324:t_004:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(That is the meaning of my life.)

324:t_005:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Be careful, $$キリコ$$! They're coming!」

324:t_006:1.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「I've confirmed the $$触れ得ざる者$$, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, and Lady $$テイタニア$$.」

324:t_006:2.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「She's already been stripped of her $$秩序の盾$$ title. She's a target for us to eliminate, too.」

324:t_006:3.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Just as headquarters told us. The apostate $$テイタニア$$ was indeed pursuing the $$触れ得ざる者$$.」

324:t_006:4.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「What shall we do about that group of black ATs?」

324:t_006:5.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「They must be the bandits we received petitions about. We'll dispose of them while we're here.」

324:t_006:6.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Father... You still want $$キリコ$$...)

324:t_006:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$... They're targeting you, too.」

324:t_006:8.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I know. But I don't intend to cause you trouble.」

324:t_007:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「We'll cover each other's blind spots.」

324:t_008:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Why...? I ended up taking $$フィアナ$$'s life, you know.」

324:t_008:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「It wasn't your fault, or anyone else's.」

324:t_008:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If you don't want to die, fight.」

324:t_008:5.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「So two who defy $$マーティアル$$ have joined forces...!」

324:t_008:6.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Captain! There are machines approaching this area!」

324:t_009:0.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「They're $$ガンダム$$s...! Heathens who defy our god!」

324:t_009:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that you in that $$ドッグ$$, $$キリコ$$!?」

324:t_009:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We've finally found other members of $c.」

324:t_009:3.en:
$$カトル$$
「It's just like him to be in the middle of a battle.」

324:t_009:4.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But he's with a $$マーティアル$$ AT...」

324:t_009:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We don't know the circumstances, but if he says so, we'll follow his lead.」

324:t_009:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So our targets are that group of black ATs and $$マーティアル$$.」

324:t_009:10.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「They seem to be enemies of each other.」

324:t_009:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We're thrown straight into a three-way hellhole?」

324:t_009:12.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It seems $$キリコ$$ isn't the only one suited to this kind of situation.」

324:t_009:13.en:
$$五飛$$
「Our opponents seem to be bandits and $$マーティアル$$'s private soldiers... Then no mercy is needed.」

324:t_010:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Look! A $$サイデリアル$$ transport ship is coming!」

324:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「What were you thinking, $$キリコ$$!? Deploying on your own without telling us!」

324:t_011:1.en:
$n
「Wait, $$カレン$$! It seems he isn't alone!」

324:t_011:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never imagined the $$プリベンター$$ group had joined him.」

324:t_011:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We received your transmission and rushed over. It seems our timing was good.」

324:t_011:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Perhaps this is another coincidence caused by an $$異能生存体$$.」

324:t_011:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Knowing you, I thought you'd be safe.」

324:t_011:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We thought the same of you.」
